identity.name: Varun Rout
identity.headline: Football Research Engineer | Sports Quantitative Modelling and Forecasting

summary: Football Research Engineer with four years across predictive modelling, forecasting and production data systems, applying statistical learning to sports and trading questions. Builds reproducible pipelines from noisy event data through held-out evaluation, benchmark comparison and deployment, proven by audited football models, power-market forecasts, sports demand analysis and close collaboration with analysts, commercial stakeholders and traders.

skills.items: Opponent-adjusted metrics, possession danger, contextual xG/xA/xT, StatsBomb event and 360 data
Logistic regression, ridge, gradient boosting, XGBoost, GRU, graph neural networks, forecasting
Held-out and cross-validation, Brier score, log loss, ROC AUC, benchmarking, calibration, leakage controls
Python, SQL, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, Azure ML Studio, GitHub Actions
Hypothesis design, reproducible experiments, trader collaboration, model limitations, decision-ready communication

roles.title: Market Analyst
bullets: Built residual-load models linking demand net of wind and solar to power prices, reducing hourly forecast RMSE by 0.3-0.5 GWh/h across near and far seasons.
Selected a three-year training window after testing multiple regimes, excluded exceptional 2022 data and monitored relationship and feature-distribution drift.
Delivered models through Azure ML Studio and Azure DevOps, explaining assumptions, errors and market drivers to analysts and commercial teams.

roles.title: Costing and Risk Intern
bullets: Built half-hourly DUoS/TNUoS forecasts and 10,000-run Monte Carlo P5/P50/P95 scenarios, then moved spreadsheet processes into Python, SQL and Snowflake, saving 6-7 hours per cycle.

experience.title: Business Analytics Consultant
bullets: Benchmarked SARIMA, Prophet, Holt-Winters and Random Forest models for six sports activity categories using out-of-sample MAE and GridSearchCV.
Translated booking, attendance and membership forecasts into staffing, scheduling and capacity recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.

experience.title: Systems Engineer
bullets: Built production data pipelines and SQL transformations using Azure Data Factory and Databricks, with controls for reliable downstream reporting.

projects.title: Opponent-Adjusted Football Metrics
projects.tools: Python, scikit-learn, StatsBomb, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, GitHub Actions
bullets: Modelled contextual expected goals and assists from 2.14 million StatsBomb events; CxG reached 0.809 ROC AUC on 15,623 shots against 0.820 for StatsBomb xG on the same sample.
Built a FastAPI and PostgreSQL service with SQLAlchemy, Alembic, 332 tests and CI for linting, typing, database smoke tests and security checks.

projects.title: Frame2Threat
projects.tools: Python, XGBoost, PyTorch, GRU, graph neural networks, SHAP, StatsBomb 360

Committed model outputs and 49 figures, documenting that added 360 context produced only marginal pass-level improvement.
